name: Vanya
desc: 钓鱼入门的引路人。DG 升到 Lv.2 时她会主动登门，送上一根钓鱼竿并解锁钓鱼爱好——之后全岛的河流、湖泊与海域都能随时下竿。
desc_en: Your guide to fishing. Once your DG reaches Lv.2 she stops by your home with a free rod and unlocks the hobby, after which you can cast a line in any river, lake or stretch of sea on the island.

name: Blanc
desc: 园艺导师。DG 达到 Lv.3 后跟他交谈即可开启园艺。起步时强烈建议先种土豆——收益约为番茄的三倍，是新手阶段回报最高的作物。
detail: 解锁：DG Lv.3 · 位置：花园街一带
desc_en: Your gardening mentor. Talk to him at DG Lv.3 to unlock gardening. Start with potatoes — they return roughly three times what tomatoes do, the best early-game crop by value.
detail_en: Unlock: DG Lv.3 · near Garden Street

name: Massimo
desc: 驻守咖啡馆的烹饪导师。DG Lv.5 拿到爱好扩展券后，建议优先解锁烹饪——它能把手头的渔获和收成加工成 2–5 倍的利润。
detail: 解锁：DG Lv.5 + 爱好扩展券 · 位置：咖啡馆
desc_en: The cooking mentor who works out of the café. Once you hold a Hobby Expansion Ticket at DG Lv.5, cooking is a strong first pick — it turns your catches and harvests into 2–5x the profit.
detail_en: Unlock: DG Lv.5 + Hobby Expansion Ticket · at the café

name: Naniwa
desc: 捕虫导师。店里出售充气昆虫诱捕器和捕虫网，同时也是 16 块拼图梦（Dream 升级材料）的购入处。
detail: 解锁：DG Lv.5/8/11 · 位置：城镇中心
desc_en: Your insect-catching mentor. She sells inflatable insect traps and bug nets, and is also where you can buy the 16 Dream Puzzles used to level up Dream.

name: Bailey J
desc: 观鸟导师。提升观鸟等级的小技巧：反复拍摄同一只鸟同样能累积进度，不必满地图追赶新鸟种。
detail: 解锁：DG Lv.5/8/11 · 位置：城镇中心
desc_en: Your birdwatching mentor. A handy leveling tip: photographing the same bird repeatedly still fills the progress bar, so you never have to chase new species across the map.

name: 琼夫人
desc: 宠物领养中心负责人。DG Lv.12 开放养猫。要注意的是，想养狗必须先完成基础的猫护理教程——这是硬性前置条件。
detail: 解锁：DG Lv.12 · 位置：宠物领养中心
desc_en: Runs the pet adoption center. Cat care opens at DG Lv.12. Note that before you can own a dog, you must finish the basic cat-care tutorial first — it is a hard prerequisite.
detail_en: Unlock: DG Lv.12 · Pet Adoption Center

name: Albert Jr.
desc: 居无定所的流浪商人，会在全岛随机游走。他收购物品的出价高于商店，长按物品即可批量售出。每天跑图时多留意他的身影。
detail: 随时可用 · 全图随机游走
desc_en: A wandering merchant with no fixed stall who roams the island at random. He pays more for items than the shops do, and long-pressing an item lets you sell it in bulk. Watch for him on your daily rounds.
detail_en: Always available · roams the map at random

name: Ka Ching
desc: 负责背包与仓库扩容的 NPC。前 5 次扩容只需 10 许愿星（原价 25），务必先把折扣次数买满。DG 到达 2/7/13/17/19 级还会额外赠送免费扩容。
detail: 随时可用 · 位置：城镇西北（住宅街外围）
desc_en: Handles backpack and storage upgrades. The first five expansions cost only 10 Wish Stars (normally 25), so it pays to max out those discounted slots first. You also get free expansions at DG Lv.2/7/13/17/19.
detail_en: Always available · northwest of town (outside Residential Street)

name: Annie
desc: 负责开启 Dream 功能的角色，DG Lv.16 后找她触发。若她迟迟不出现，重新登录即可。快速升级 Dream 的捷径是去捕虫商店买满 16 块拼图梦。
detail: 解锁：DG Lv.16 · 位置：城镇中心
desc_en: Unlocks the Dream feature once you reach DG Lv.16. If she does not appear, just log back in. The quickest way to level Dream is to buy all 16 Dream Puzzles from the bug shop.

name: Dorothy
desc: 每日食物任务的发布者，同时也是服装店店主。她常年待在服装店里，随时都能找到。
detail: 随时可用 · 位置：服装店
desc_en: Posts the daily food quest and also owns the clothing shop. She is always inside the clothing store, so you can find her any time.
detail_en: Always available · at the clothing shop

name: Bob
desc: 中心商店街的杂货店老板，出售各类基础物资。
detail: 商店 · 位置：中心商店街
desc_en: The general-store owner on the main shopping street, selling a range of basic supplies.

name: Atara
desc: 活动与周常任务的 NPC。完成周常任务可领取额外奖励。
desc_en: Handles event and weekly quests. Clearing the weekly quests earns you extra rewards.

name: 收藏家
desc: 收集品兑换 NPC，可用你收集来的物品换取奖励。
desc_en: Exchanges collectibles for rewards — bring the items you have gathered to trade them in.

name: Andrew
desc: 工具相关的特殊 NPC，位于城镇东侧。
desc_en: A specialist NPC on the east side of town who handles tool services.

name: Eric
desc: 住在温泉山一带的居民。
desc_en: A resident who lives around Onsen Mountain.

name: Will
desc: 住在西南海岸灯塔旁的居民，也是灯塔的建造者。
desc_en: A resident of the southwest coast who built the Lighthouse.

name: Patti
desc: 森林护林员，驻守在鹿塔/森林入口附近。
desc_en: A forest ranger stationed near the Deer Tower at the forest entrance.

name: Vernie
desc: 花田管理员，常在风车花田的风车旁露营。
desc_en: The flower-field caretaker who camps on the hill by the windmill.

name: Bill
desc: 渔村一带的活动相关 NPC。
desc_en: An event NPC found around Fisherman Village.

name: Doris
desc: 艺术街附近的特殊 NPC。
desc_en: A specialist NPC near Arts Street.

name: 萤石矿
desc: 每天刷新一次，产出用于建筑的萤石，位于温泉山/火山湖一带的巨石阵。
detail: 每天刷新 · 温泉山巨石阵
desc_en: Respawns once a day and yields fluorite for building, found at the stone formation near Onsen Mountain / Volcano Lake.
detail_en: Respawns daily · Onsen Mountain stone formation

name: 大树采集点
desc: 每日刷新的大树资源，可收获木材与若干特殊材料。
detail: 每天刷新 · 分散于多个区域
desc_en: A large tree resource that respawns daily, giving wood and a few special materials.

name: 矿石点
desc: 可采集石头与矿物，每日刷新，用于建造与制作。
desc_en: Yields stone and ore that respawn daily, used for building and crafting.

name: 矿石点
desc: 可采集石头与矿物，位于遗迹一带。
desc_en: A spot for stone and ore, located near the Ruins.

name: 矿石点
desc: 能采到石头和矿物，位置在森林一带。
desc_en: A spot for stone and ore, located in the forest.

name: 蘑菇采集点
desc: 森林里的蘑菇群，秋季产量最丰。属于免费食材，烤蘑菇几乎零成本就能赚钱，每天跑图时顺路采上一把即可。
detail: 最佳季节：秋 · 森林一带
desc_en: A mushroom cluster in the forest that peaks in autumn. These free ingredients make roast mushrooms an almost zero-cost earner, so it is worth grabbing a handful on your daily rounds.

name: 蘑菇采集点
desc: 密林深处的蘑菇群，秋天产量最高。
detail: 最佳季节：秋 · 密林深处
desc_en: A mushroom cluster deep in the forest that peaks in autumn.

name: 蘑菇采集点
desc: 水边的蘑菇点，雨过之后出现几率更高。
detail: 最佳季节：秋 · 水边一带
desc_en: A waterside mushroom patch that appears more often after rain.

name: 浆果灌木
desc: 散布在全地图各处。免费水果，4 颗做成果酱可卖 170 金币，每天跑一圈就能全部采完。
detail: 全岛散落 · 4 颗可制果酱售 170 金币
desc_en: Scattered all over the map. These free fruit sell for 170 gold when four are made into jam, and a single daily loop clears them all.

name: 浆果灌木
desc: 长在花田旁的浆果丛，顺路做任务时就能随手采。
desc_en: A berry bush near the Flower Fields you can pick on your way to quests.

name: 浆果灌木
desc: 城镇周边的浆果丛，做任务途中可以顺手摘。
desc_en: A berry bush near town you can pick on your way to quests.

name: 浆果灌木
desc: 郊区的浆果丛，刷新速度很快。
desc_en: A berry bush in the Suburbs that respawns very often.

name: 浆果灌木
desc: 河对岸的浆果丛，容易被忽略，但刷新量相当可观。
desc_en: A berry bush across the river that is easy to miss but respawns a generous amount.

name: 果树群
desc: 森林边缘的果树群。每棵树敲一下就能摘果，约 2 分钟后重新长。注意第一下必掉水果，后两下只掉木材。
detail: 位置：森林边缘 · 约 2 分钟刷新
desc_en: A grove at the forest edge. Shake each tree once to pick fruit; it refreshes in about 2 minutes. Note that the first shake always drops fruit, while the next two only give wood.

name: 果树群
desc: 森林南缘的果树，每棵树敲一下即可摘果。
detail: 位置：森林南缘 · 约 2 分钟刷新
desc_en: Fruit trees on the south edge of the forest — shake each once to pick fruit.
detail_en: Location: south forest edge · ~2 min respawn

name: 果树
desc: 路旁的柠檬树，柠檬是好几种食谱的配料。
detail: 位置：路边 · 约 2 分钟刷新
desc_en: A lemon tree by the road; lemons are an ingredient in several recipes.

name: 果树群
desc: 森林湖边的野生果树。
desc_en: Wild fruit trees near Forest Lake.

name: 金色泡泡
desc: 会在地图各处随机冒出，里面装着能量、材料、服装等奖励。经过时记得捡，是免费拿稀有物品的重要来源。
desc_en: Appears at random across the map and can hold energy, materials, clothing and more. Always pick these up as you pass — they are a key free source of rare items.

name: 金色泡泡
desc: 随机出现在地图各处，装着能量、材料、服装等奖励，路过记得顺手捡。
desc_en: Appears at random across the map with energy, materials, clothing and other rewards — grab them as you pass.

name: 金色泡泡
desc: 随机出现在地图各处，装着能量、材料、服装等奖励，路过记得顺手捡。
desc_en: Appears at random across the map with energy, materials, clothing and other rewards — grab them as you pass.

name: Meadow湖
desc: Meadow 湖钓点，蝴蝶锦鲤、胡瓜鱼、金鱼在此出没。全年全天都能下竿，是新手最便捷的日常钓点。
detail: 鱼种：蝴蝶锦鲤/胡瓜鱼/金鱼
desc_en: A fishing spot on Meadow Lake where Butterfly Koi, Smelt and Goldfish turn up. It can be fished all year, all day, making it the most convenient daily spot for beginners.

name: 森林湖
desc: 森林湖钓点，鲈鱼、小龙虾、红点鲑在此出没，旁边也是蘑菇采集地。
detail: 鱼种：鲈鱼/小龙虾/红点鲑
desc_en: A fishing spot on Forest Lake where Bass, Crayfish and Char appear, next to a mushroom-picking area.

name: 郊区湖
desc: 郊区湖钓点，鲫鱼、鲷鱼、白鱼在此出没。紧邻农地，做完日常采集顺路来钓最方便。
desc_en: A fishing spot on Suburban Lake with Crucian Carp, Seabream and Whitefish. Right next to the farm fields, so it is an easy stop after your daily gathering.

name: 温泉山湖
desc: 温泉山湖钓点，蓝鳃太阳鱼、杜父鱼在此出没。位置稍偏，但鱼种别具特色。
detail: 鱼种：蓝鳃太阳鱼/杜父鱼
desc_en: A fishing spot on Onsen Mountain Lake with Bluegill and Sculpin. A little out of the way, but the species are distinctive.

name: 火山湖
desc: 火山湖钓点，有特色鱼种出没，想集齐图鉴一定要来。
desc_en: A fishing spot on Volcano Lake with some unique species — a must if you want a complete collection log.

name: 极光河
desc: 极光河沿岸的一个钓鱼位置。
desc_en: A fishing spot along the Aurora River.

name: 浅滩河
desc: 浅滩河段，这里能钓到鲃鱼。
desc_en: A stretch of the Shallow River where Barbel appear.

name: 静谧河
desc: 静谧河段，江鱈、鲑鱼在这里出没。沿河道一路边走边钓，效率很高。
desc_en: A stretch of the Tranquil River with Burbot and Salmon. Work your way along the bank and you will haul them in fast.

name: 巨树河
desc: 巨树河段，这里能钓到多瑙哲罗鱼。
desc_en: A stretch of the Giant Tree River where Huchen appear.

name: 渔村码头
desc: 渔村码头的海钓点，全年全天都能钓到鲑鱼、沙丁鱼。紧邻渔具店方便补给，是日常海钓的首选。
detail: 鱼种：鲑鱼/沙丁鱼及多种海鱼
desc_en: A sea-fishing spot at the Fisherman Village dock where you can catch Salmon and Sardine all year, all day. Right next to the tackle shop for easy resupply, it is the go-to spot for daily sea fishing.
detail_en: Fish: Salmon · Sardine · assorted sea fish

name: 东码头
desc: 东码头的海钓点，能钓到不少海鱼。
desc_en: A sea-fishing spot at the East Dock with a variety of saltwater fish.

name: 鲸鱼海
desc: 鲸鱼海的钓点，鲭鱼、大西洋鲑鱼在这里出没。
desc_en: A fishing spot in Whale Sea where Mackerel and Atlantic Salmon appear.

name: 古海
desc: 古海海域上的一个抛竿位置。
desc_en: A fishing spot in the Ancient Sea.

name: 静海
desc: 静海海域上的一个抛竿位置。
desc_en: A fishing spot in the Calm Sea.

name: 远洋活动区
desc: 海上钓鱼活动的专用区域，出金枪鱼（夏）、帝王蟹（冬）、月鱼（夜间）。注意同一周重复参加费用会一次比一次高。
detail: 仅活动周 · 金枪鱼/帝王蟹/月鱼
desc_en: A dedicated zone for the ocean fishing event, yielding Tuna (summer), King Crab (winter) and Moonfish (night). Note that repeat entries in the same week cost progressively more.
detail_en: Event weeks only · Tuna · King Crab · Moonfish

name: Dorothy服装店
desc: 位于城镇中心的服装店，服装库存每日刷新。Dorothy 同时还是每日食物任务的发布者。
desc_en: The clothing shop in Town Center with a stock that refreshes daily. Dorothy also posts the daily food quest from here.

name: 家具市场
desc: 拥有 2000 多种可交互组件，按现代、田园、海洋、童话等主题分类。DG 等级决定可解锁的种类，DG Lv.15 会开放高级建造模式。
detail: 2000+ 组件 · 可解锁种类随 DG 等级提升
desc_en: Boasts 2,000+ interactive pieces organized into themes like Modern, Countryside, Ocean and Fairy Tale. Your DG level decides which categories unlock, and DG Lv.15 opens the advanced build mode.
detail_en: 2,000+ pieces · unlocks scale with DG level

name: 宠物商店
desc: 卖宠物相关物品，就在宠物领养中心旁边。
desc_en: Sells pet supplies and sits right next to the pet adoption center.
detail_en: Location: next to the Pet Adoption Center

name: 书店
desc: 卖蓝图和配方书，少数稀有蓝图要 DG 达到一定等级才会开放。
detail: 位置：城镇中心 · 蓝图/配方书
desc_en: Sells blueprints and recipe books; some rare blueprints only unlock at certain DG levels.
detail_en: Location: Town Center · blueprints & recipe books

name: 中心商店街
desc: 城镇中心的主街，服装店、家具店、杂货铺都开在这里。货品每天补新，值得天天来逛。
detail: 位置：城镇中心主街 · 每日补货
desc_en: The main street in Town Center, home to the clothing, furniture and general stores. Stock refreshes daily, so it is worth a visit every day.
detail_en: Location: main street, Town Center · daily restock

name: Massimo咖啡馆
desc: 出售肉、奶酪、奶油、黄油等烹饪材料。冬季限定：企鹅炉灶（做冰饮必备，普通炉灶做不了冰咖啡）。
detail: 位置：城镇中心 · 企鹅炉灶（仅冬季）
desc_en: Sells meat, cheese, cream, butter and other cooking ingredients. Winter exclusive: the Penguin Stove — essential for iced drinks, since a normal stove cannot make iced coffee.
detail_en: Location: Town Center · Penguin Stove (winter only)

name: 捕虫商店
desc: 在 Naniwa 处购买。卖充气昆虫诱捕器和捕虫网，16 块拼图梦（升级 Dream 的素材）也在这里。
detail: NPC：Naniwa · 诱捕器/捕虫网/拼图梦
desc_en: Run by Naniwa. Sells inflatable insect traps and bug nets, and is also where you can buy the 16 Dream Puzzles used to level up Dream.
detail_en: NPC: Naniwa · traps · nets · Dream Puzzles

name: 渔具店
desc: 开在渔村一带，卖鱼饵和修理工具。海上钓鱼活动期间还会上架限定商品。
desc_en: In the Fisherman Village area, selling bait and repair tools. During ocean fishing events it also stocks limited-time items.

name: 镀金橡果展览
desc: 扭蛋/抽卡系统。展览票券能跨池保留，别急着花掉——先攒着，等想要的物品轮换进池子再集中抽。精密乐器和稀有家具主要从这里出。
detail: 票券跨池保留 · 稀有家具/精密乐器
desc_en: A gacha-style draw system. Exhibition tickets carry over between pools, so do not spend them in a hurry — save up and pull in bulk once an item you want rotates in. It is the source of precision instruments and rare furniture.
detail_en: Tickets carry over between pools · rare furniture & instruments

name: 中央广场
desc: 岛屿的心脏地带，商店街、咖啡馆、广场都聚在这里，多数 NPC 也在此活动。
detail: 核心区域 · NPC 聚集
desc_en: The heart of the island, home to the shopping street, café and plaza. Most NPCs hang around here.

name: 灵橡松林
desc: 东边的森林，昆虫、蘑菇、木材主要都从这里获取，也是捕虫和观鸟的重点地带。
detail: 森林地带 · 昆虫/蘑菇/木材
desc_en: The eastern forest, a main source of insects, mushrooms and wood, and a key area for both insect catching and birdwatching.

name: 渔村
desc: 位于南边的渔村，有渔具店和码头。海钓首选这里，全年全天都能下竿。
desc_en: A village in the south with a tackle shop and dock. It is the top choice for sea fishing, available all year, all day.

name: 花田
desc: 西北边的花田，花种很多，适合捕虫和观鸟。
desc_en: A flower-filled area in the northwest with many bloom varieties, great for insect catching and birdwatching.

name: 温泉山
desc: 东北部的温泉山区，山湖就在此地。视野开阔，可俯瞰整座岛。
detail: 温泉山 · 山湖钓鱼区
desc_en: A hot-spring mountain in the northeast, home to the mountain lake. The wide-open view overlooks the whole island.

name: 鲸鱼山
desc: 北边的一片山区。
desc_en: A mountainous area in the north.

name: 岩石崖
desc: 东海岸的悬崖地带，风景很有特色。
desc_en: A cliff along the east coast with distinctive scenery.

name: 码头
desc: 西边的一处码头。
desc_en: A pier on the west side of the island.

name: 灯塔
desc: 西南海岸的灯塔，风景漂亮，很适合拍照。
desc_en: A lighthouse on the southwest coast with lovely views — a great photo spot.

name: 郊区
desc: 西边的郊区，可以种地，Ka Ching 的背包扩容店也开在这里。
desc_en: The western Suburbs, where you can grow crops. Ka Ching's storage-upgrade shop is here too.

name: 森林岛
desc: 东部的一座离岛，覆盖着森林。
desc_en: A forested offshore island to the east.

name: 紫罗兰海滩
desc: 一处海滩地带。
desc_en: A stretch of beach.

name: 艺术街
desc: 以艺术为主题的街区。
desc_en: An arts district.

name: 花园街
desc: 花园街区，Blanc 就在附近，常有昆虫和鸟类出没。
desc_en: A garden district where Blanc lives nearby, with insects and birds often about.

name: 居民街
desc: 居民区，好几位 NPC 的家都在这条街上。
desc_en: A residential street that is home to several NPCs.

name: 潜水板
desc: 跳水的位置，就在熊猫旁边。
desc_en: A diving spot, right near the panda.

name: 东码头
desc: 东侧的大码头，海钓和出海活动都从这里出发。
desc_en: A large dock on the east side, the starting point for sea fishing and boat trips.

name: 玩家家园
desc: 你的家园！种田、烹饪、建造都在这里完成，也是每天跑图的起点和终点。
desc_en: Your home! Farming, cooking and building all happen here, and it is where every run around the map starts and ends.

name: 风车花田
desc: 风车和花田组成的景观地带。
desc_en: A scenic area made up of windmills and flower fields.

name: 巴士站·中央广场
desc: 中央广场的巴士站，可快速赶往其他车站。
desc_en: The Central Plaza bus stop, which lets you fast-travel to the other stops.

name: 巴士站·渔村
desc: 渔村的巴士站，从城镇过来很方便。
desc_en: The Fisherman Village bus stop, a quick ride from town to the village.

name: 巴士站·郊区
desc: 西部郊区的巴士站，紧挨着农田。
desc_en: A bus stop in the western Suburbs, right by the farm fields.

name: 巴士站·花田
desc: 花田旁的巴士站。
desc_en: A bus stop at the Flower Fields.

name: 巴士站·森林
desc: 森林的巴士站，离灵橡松林入口不远。
desc_en: A bus stop in the forest, near the entrance to Oak Pine Forest.

name: 巴士站·温泉山
desc: 温泉山的巴士站，去山湖钓鱼的出发点。
desc_en: A bus stop on Onsen Mountain, the starting point for mountain-lake fishing.

name: 巴士站·北郊
desc: 北郊的一处巴士站。
desc_en: A bus stop in the north suburbs.

name: 巴士站·郊区村
desc: 郊区村的一处巴士站。
desc_en: A bus stop in the suburb village.

name: 野兔
desc: 常在郊区和农田一带活动，拂晓与黄昏时段最常现身。
detail: 郊区/农田 · 晨昏活跃
desc_en: Appears near the Suburbs and farm fields, most active at dawn and dusk.

name: 狐狸
desc: 花田周边能碰到它，是比较少见的野外动物。
desc_en: Appears near the Flower Fields; a rare wild animal.

name: 小鹿
desc: 偶尔在密林深处露面，身形矫健，人一靠近就会受惊逃开。
desc_en: Occasionally appears deep in the forest. It is skittish and bolts if you get too close.

name: 熊猫
desc: 南部竹林里能看到它，就在跳跳乐楼梯旁；喂竹子可以和它互动。
detail: 南部竹林 · 跳跳乐旁
desc_en: Appears in the southern bamboo grove, right by the jump-puzzle staircase; feed it bamboo to interact.
detail_en: Southern bamboo · near the jump puzzle

name: 水豚
desc: 活动范围在遗迹一带。
desc_en: Appears around the Ruins.

name: 海獭
desc: 活动在渔村周边的水域。
desc_en: Appears in the waters near Fisherman Village.

name: 雪貂
desc: 只出现在个别区域，相当罕见。
desc_en: Only appears in specific areas and is very rare.

name: 羊驼
desc: 出没地点在紫罗兰海滩附近。
desc_en: Appears near Violet Beach.

name: 活动限定观鸟
desc: 只在百巢活动等特殊事件中出现的稀有鸟类，例如孔雀、金刚鹦鹉等。
detail: 仅活动期间 · 平时看不到
desc_en: Rare birds such as peacocks and macaws that only show up during special events like the Hundred-Nest event.

name: 水边观鸟区
desc: 栖息于河流、湖泊等水域的水鸟，以鸭类、火烈鸟等为主。
detail: 观鸟等级需求：1-5 · 多为鸭类与涉禽
desc_en: Water birds that live along rivers and lakes, mostly ducks, flamingos and similar.
detail_en: Birdwatching Lv.1-5 · mostly ducks and waders

name: 花田观鸟区
desc: 花田地区鸟种丰富，火烈鸟、果鸠等都在此出没。
detail: 观鸟等级需求：1-9 · 种类最丰富的地点之一
desc_en: A bird-rich area in the Flower Fields, with flamingos, fruit doves and more.
detail_en: Birdwatching Lv.1-9 · one of the most diverse spots

name: 渔村观鸟区
desc: 渔村、灯塔和码头周围的海鸟与水边鸟类。
desc_en: Sea and waterside birds around Fisherman Village, the lighthouse and the dock.

name: 远洋观鸟区
desc: 远洋与离岛一带的珍稀海鸟，有鸬鹚、燕鸥等。
detail: 观鸟等级需求：3-9 · 珍稀海鸟
desc_en: Rare sea birds of the open ocean and islands, including cormorants and terns.

name: 灵橡松林观鸟区
desc: 灵橡松林中心地带的鸟类，有啄木鸟、园丁鸟等。
desc_en: Birds of the core Oak Pine Forest, including woodpeckers and bowerbirds.

name: 火山口湖观鸟区
desc: 火山口湖和遗迹一带的高地鸟类。
desc_en: Highland birds of the crater lake and Ruins area.

name: 风车花田观鸟区
desc: 风车花田和鲸鱼山周边的特有鸟种。
desc_en: Birds unique to the windmill flower fields and the Whale Mountain area.

name: 郊区观鸟区
desc: 郊区和农田一带的鸟类，有蓝鸲、朱顶雀等，是鸟种最密集的观鸟地点。
detail: 观鸟等级需求：2-9 · 鸟种最丰富
desc_en: Birds of the Suburbs and farmlands, including bluebirds and redpolls — the most diverse birdwatching area.

name: 家园/中心区观鸟
desc: 家园与中央广场附近的常见鸟类，最适合新手观测。
desc_en: Common birds around your home and Central Plaza — the best place for beginners to start.

name: 森林岛观鸟区
desc: 只有森林岛才有的鸟种。
desc_en: Birds found only on Forest Island.

name: 海岸观鸟区
desc: 栖居在海滩与岸边的海鸟，主要有鸥类、燕鸥等。
desc_en: Sea birds along the beach and shore, including gulls and terns.

name: 温泉山观鸟区
desc: 温泉山一带的鸟类，有山雀、雕鸮等。
detail: 观鸟等级需求：1-7 · 山雀与猛禽较多
desc_en: Birds of the Onsen Mountain area, including tits and eagle-owls.
detail_en: Birdwatching Lv.1-7 · several tits and raptors

name: 鹿塔观鸟区
desc: 鹿塔周围可见猛禽和一些特有鸟种。
detail: 观鸟等级需求：5-8 · 有红隼等猛禽
desc_en: Birds of prey and unique species near the forest Deer Tower.
detail_en: Birdwatching Lv.5-8 · raptors like the kestrel

name: 跳跃谜题观鸟区
desc: 森林跳跃谜题与跳水板附近的鸟类。
desc_en: Birds near the forest jump puzzle and diving board.

name: 风车花田捕虫区
desc: 风车花田一带，有珍珠蝶、孔雀蛱蝶、展足木蜂出没。
desc_en: The windmill flower fields, where Mother-of-Pearl, Peacock Butterfly and Splay-footed Carpenter Bee appear.

name: 森林岛捕虫区
desc: 森林岛上的高山天牛，只在彩虹天气才会现身。
detail: 捕捉等级需求：5 · 仅限彩虹天气
desc_en: The Alpine Longhorn Beetle on Forest Island, which only shows up in rainbow weather.

name: 灵橡松林捕虫区
desc: 灵橡松林核心区域，闪蝶、锹甲、凤蝶等稀有品种在此出没。
detail: 捕捉等级需求：2-8 · 蝴蝶和甲虫居多
desc_en: The core Oak Pine Forest, home to rare morpho butterflies, stag beetles and swallowtails.
detail_en: Catching Lv.2-8 · mostly butterflies and beetles

name: 鹿塔捕虫区
desc: 鹿塔附近，异色瓢虫、蓑蛾、杜鹃蜂等在这里出没。
desc_en: Near the forest Deer Tower, where the Harlequin Ladybird, Bagworm Moth, Cuckoo Bee and more appear.

name: 渔村捕虫区
desc: 渔村及周边，菜粉蝶、蚂蚁、角甲虫、豹纹蛱蝶等在此出没。
desc_en: In and around Fisherman Village, with Cabbage White, Ants, Horned Beetles, Leopard Butterflies and more.

name: 跳跃谜题捕虫区
desc: 森林跳跃谜题一带，有金宝石金龟、锹形虫出没。
desc_en: The forest jump-puzzle area, where the Golden Jewel Scarab and Stag Beetle appear.

name: 花田捕虫区
desc: 花田地区，熊蜂、芦笋甲虫、花金龟等多种昆虫在此出没。
detail: 捕捉等级需求：1-8 · 蝴蝶和蜜蜂居多
desc_en: The Flower Fields, with bumblebees, asparagus beetles, flower chafers and more.
detail_en: Catching Lv.1-8 · mostly butterflies and bees

name: 家园/岩石捕虫
desc: 家园和岩石周边的常见昆虫。
desc_en: Common insects around your home and the rocks.

name: 诱饵活动捕虫
desc: 在诱饵活动与充气诱捕器中出现的特殊昆虫，例如阿波罗绢蝶、彩虹锹甲等。
detail: 仅活动/诱饵 · 稀有品种
desc_en: Special insects that appear during bait events and in inflatable traps, such as the Apollo Butterfly and Rainbow Stag Beetle.

name: 稀有/未知来源
desc: 来源不详的稀有昆虫，可能要满足特定条件才会碰到。
detail: 出现条件不明 · 需自行探索
desc_en: Rare insects of unknown origin that may only appear under specific conditions.
detail_en: Unknown spawn conditions · explore to find

name: 郊区捕虫区
desc: 郊区与农地，粉蝶、瓢虫、月蛾、鸟翼蝶等在此出没。
desc_en: The Suburbs and farmlands, with brimstones, ladybugs, moon moths, birdwings and more.

name: 温泉山捕虫区
desc: 温泉山一带，螳螂、虎甲、金蝗虫、绿虎甲等在此出没。
detail: 捕捉等级需求：3-7 · 螳螂和甲虫居多
desc_en: The Onsen Mountain area, with mantises, tiger beetles, gold grasshoppers, green tiger beetles and more.
detail_en: Catching Lv.3-7 · mostly mantises and beetles

name: 水边捕虫区
desc: 水边与河边，蜻蜓、豆娘、蟌等水边昆虫在此出没。
detail: 捕捉等级需求：2-5 · 蜻蜓居多
desc_en: Along the water and riverbanks, with dragonflies and damselflies and other waterside insects.

name: 遗迹捕虫区
desc: 火山口湖和遗迹一带的高地昆虫。
detail: 捕捉等级需求：5-8 · 稀有甲虫
desc_en: Highland insects of the crater lake and Ruins area.

name: Rosy河
desc: Rosy 河的钓点，鲤鱼、淡水鳚、施氏鲈在这里出没。
detail: 鱼种：鲤鱼/淡水鳚/施氏鲈
desc_en: A fishing spot on the Rosy River where Carp, Freshwater Blenny and Streber appear.

name: Zephyr海
desc: Zephyr 海的钓点，海鲷、龙虾、带鱼等海鱼在此出没。
detail: 鱼种：海鲷/带鱼/龙虾/章鱼
desc_en: A fishing spot in Zephyr Sea with Seabream, Lobster, Beltfish and other saltwater species.

name: 东海
desc: 东海的钓点，虾虎鱼、虾、黑线鳕、翻车鱼等在此出没。
detail: 鱼种：虾虎鱼/普通虾/黑线鳕/翻车鱼
desc_en: A fishing spot in the East Sea where Goby, Shrimp, Haddock, Ocean Sunfish and more appear.
detail_en: Fish: Goby · Shrimp · Haddock · Ocean Sunfish

name: 上森林湖
desc: 上森林湖的钓点，是一片藏在密林深处的高地湖泊。
detail: 森林高地 · 湖泊钓点
desc_en: A fishing spot on Upper Forest Lake, a highland lake tucked deep in the forest.

name: 远洋活动区
desc: 远洋钓点，兔子鱼、沙丁鱼、海鲈鱼、鲣鱼在此出没，属于海上钓鱼活动区域。
detail: 鱼种：兔子鱼/沙丁鱼/海鲈鱼/鲣鱼
desc_en: An ocean fishing point where Rabbitfish, Sardine, Sea Bass and Skipjack Tuna appear, part of the offshore fishing event area.
detail_en: Fish: Rabbitfish · Sardine · Sea Bass · Skipjack Tuna

desc: 古老遗迹一带，水豚、火山湖就在旁边，适合探索和观鸟。
name: 遗迹
desc_en: An ancient ruin site near the capybara and Volcano Lake — a good spot for exploring and birdwatching.

desc: 东边的浮桥，是连接河两岸的重要通路。
name: 东浮桥
desc_en: A pontoon bridge in the east that serves as an important crossing between the river banks.

desc: 密林深处的高地湖泊，环境安静，适合钓鱼和观鸟。
name: 上森林湖
desc_en: A quiet highland lake deep in the forest, suited to fishing and birdwatching.

desc: 地图最北端的一片古老海域，小丑鱼、欧洲鳗鱼等鱼类在这里游动。
name: 古海
detail: 北部海域 · 古海钓鱼区
desc_en: An ancient sea at the far north of the map, home to Clownfish, European Eel and more.

desc: 西边的鲸鱼海，海马、帝王蟹、竹荚鱼等在此出没。
name: 鲸鱼海
detail: 西部海域 · 鲸鱼海钓鱼区
desc_en: Whale Sea in the west, where Seahorse, King Crab, Horse Mackerel and more appear.

desc: Rosy 河流经城镇中心附近，是鲤鱼和淡水鳚的主要栖息地。
name: Rosy河
detail: 河道 · Rosy 河钓鱼区
desc_en: The Rosy River runs near Town Center and is the main home of Carp and Freshwater Blenny.
